2026-11-05.headline: Purview retention splits Copilot coverage; auto-labeling capped at 500,000 files daily
2026-11-05.overview: Two administrator-relevant updates stand out. Beginning January 15, 2027, the “Teams chats and Copilot interactions” retention location will cover Teams content only, while updated Information Protection guidance defines 500,000 automatically labeled SharePoint and OneDrive files per tenant per day as an absolute aggregate ceiling across all auto-labeling policies, not a guaranteed processing rate. Related Purview pages now reflect the same ceiling.
2026-11-05.adminImpact: Administrators needing Microsoft 365 Copilot interaction retention should create a separate retention policy using the “Microsoft Copilot Experiences” location. For auto-labeling, plan against one tenant-wide limit across all policies and expect actual throughput to be lower than 500,000 files per day; Teams retention behavior remains unchanged.

keyChanges.title: Teams and Copilot retention coverage separates on January 15, 2027
keyChanges.detail: Policies using “Teams chats and Copilot interactions” will apply only to Teams content beginning January 15, 2027. They will no longer retain or delete Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions, including previously retained interactions. Use the separate “Microsoft Copilot Experiences” location when Copilot retention is required.

keyChanges.title: Auto-labeling throughput is an aggregate tenant ceiling, not a rate
keyChanges.detail: The limit for automatically labeled SharePoint and OneDrive files is stated as an absolute maximum of 500,000 files per tenant per day across all auto-labeling policies. Actual throughput may be lower, so administrators should assess volume across the tenant rather than treating the figure as an expected daily processing rate.

2026-11-06.headline: DLP adds a control to exclude external emails from Copilot grounding
2026-11-06.overview: A new admin-configurable Purview DLP control is described for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat. It restricts processing of email from external or untrusted domains while preserving internal data use. The period also adds more precise auto-label simulation troubleshooting and a new audit activity for gateway datasource status tests.
2026-11-06.adminImpact: Administrators can assess the DLP control against their Copilot data-handling requirements and track the stated public preview and general availability timing. For auto-label simulations, they can distinguish failed jobs from requests that never started, interpret partial results, preserve useful results before restarting, and review workload details before enabling a policy. Audit teams can use the new activity name to identify tenant administrator connection status tests.

keyChanges.title: DLP can exclude external email from Copilot grounding
keyChanges.detail: The Message Center item describes a new admin-configurable DLP control for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat. It excludes email from external or untrusted domains from Copilot grounding while maintaining internal data use; the item lists public preview in June 2026 and general availability in June 2027.

keyChanges.title: Auto-label guidance adds failure and partial-result handling
keyChanges.detail: The Auto Label Simulation Results article adds the “Simulation failed” status, distinguishes failed jobs from requests that could not start, explains partial workload counts, and provides guidance for reviewing or restarting simulations. Administrators are told to preserve useful results before restarting and review workload details before enabling a policy.

keyChanges.title: Audit references gateway datasource status test activity
keyChanges.detail: The Audit Log Activities reference now includes GetGatewayClusterDatasourceStatusAsAdmin for tenant administrator connection status tests, giving administrators the activity name needed to identify those tests in audit records.

keyChanges.title: Sensitivity-label guidance links simulation failure details
keyChanges.detail: Apply Sensitivity Label Automatically now links to guidance for simulation failure messages and results marked “(partial)”. The change helps administrators find the relevant troubleshooting guidance when simulations fail or produce partial results.

2026-11-07.headline: Audit activity reference adds Power BI MCP semantic-model event names
2026-11-07.overview: The Audit Log Activities documentation now lists events for Power BI MCP tools that modify semantic models and read semantic model metadata.
2026-11-07.adminImpact: Administrators can use these activity names when reviewing or interpreting audit logs. No action is required.

keyChanges.title: Power BI MCP activity coverage documented
keyChanges.detail: The activity reference adds event names for MCP tools modifying semantic models and reading semantic model metadata.

2026-11-09.headline: Purview retires four DSPM partner integrations December 7 as permissions auditing expands
2026-11-09.overview: Microsoft Purview will retire its Varonis, BigID, Cyera, and OneTrust DSPM integrations for non-Microsoft data sources on December 7, 2026. Separately, Purview is adding two audit operations for role-based access control, with worldwide rollout scheduled from late September through mid-November 2026.
2026-11-09.adminImpact: Administrators using the affected DSPM integrations should review dependencies before December 7; those integrations will stop ingesting and displaying data, while other DSPM capabilities remain unaffected. The permissions-audit improvements require no action but should provide more visibility for investigating access issues and monitoring compliance.

keyChanges.title: Four DSPM partner integrations will retire
keyChanges.detail: On December 7, 2026, Purview will retire the Varonis, BigID, Cyera, and OneTrust integrations for non-Microsoft data sources. They will no longer ingest or display data; other DSPM capabilities remain unaffected. Microsoft says no action is required, but administrators should review dependencies if they use these integrations.

keyChanges.title: RBAC permissions auditing gains two operations
keyChanges.detail: Purview is adding two new audit operations for role-based access control, improving transparency and troubleshooting for access issues. The enhancement is rolling out worldwide from late September through mid-November 2026 and requires no administrator action.

2026-11-10.headline: Purview DLP guidance names Cowork while DSPM documents Copilot label-inheritance limits
2026-11-10.overview: Cowork is the day's main thread: DLP guidance now calls the location “Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork,” adds Cowork to setup examples and supported experiences, and states that administrative-unit scoping applies to Cowork for Microsoft Copilot and Chat. DSPM guidance defines when new Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and PDF content can inherit source sensitivity labels and protection. Insider Risk also clarifies alternate-email associations, while two Message Center announcements outline a mid-2027 Endpoint DLP AI capability and a late-November 2026 Edge for Business setup change.
2026-11-10.adminImpact: Use the expanded Cowork wording when configuring DLP and verify administrative-unit-scoped coverage. For DSPM, set expectations using the documented 50 MB, label-availability, and user-defined-permission limits. Review alternate email addresses when Insider Risk activity appears under an unexpected profile. For planning, the Endpoint DLP skills require Security Copilot enabled; the Edge change adds Intune multi-admin approval and requires no policy migration.

keyChanges.title: DLP guidance now carries Cowork through location and scope references
keyChanges.detail: The DLP location is now named “Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork,” with Cowork added to setup guidance, examples, and supported experiences. The policy reference also states that administrative-unit scoping applies to Cowork for Microsoft Copilot and Chat.

keyChanges.title: DSPM documents sensitivity-label inheritance limits for Copilot content
keyChanges.detail: The guidance says new Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and PDF content can inherit the source item's sensitivity label and protection settings. User-defined-permission labels are unsupported, and labeling does not occur when the label is unavailable to the user or the file exceeds 50 MB.

keyChanges.title: Insider Risk explains alternate-email profile associations
keyChanges.detail: Insider Risk guidance now says alternate email addresses, including Microsoft Entra ID’s Other mail values, associate activity and historical activity with user profiles. Changing an address does not correct existing alerts or historical associations.

keyChanges.title: Endpoint DLP AI skills target mid-2027 with Security Copilot required
keyChanges.detail: A Message Center announcement describes AI-powered Policy Sync and Device Health skills for real-time visibility into policy deployment and synchronization issues, impacted devices, root causes, and remediation actions. The rollout is targeted for mid-2027 and requires Security Copilot enabled in the tenant.

keyChanges.title: Edge for Business DLP setup adds Intune multi-admin approval
keyChanges.detail: Purview DLP setup and activation for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business will gain clearer status, detailed errors, and task coordination between Purview and Intune administrators starting in late November 2026. No policy migration is needed.

2026-11-12.headline: Purview AI-readiness article adds action-oriented guidance and a four-part admin summary
2026-11-12.overview: The period brought one Purview update: the AI and Copilot guidance now presents recommendations more directly and adds a Summary section covering Purview’s role in understanding data, protecting sensitive information, investigating risks, and governing AI interactions.
2026-11-12.adminImpact: Admins preparing for AI apps and agents get clearer guidance for identifying and addressing data-protection gaps before those systems use organizational data.

keyChanges.title: AI-readiness guidance is more action-oriented
keyChanges.detail: The “Protect Sensitive Data To Get Ready For AI” article now uses action-oriented wording for its recommendations and adds a Summary section explaining how Purview can help admins understand data, protect sensitive information, investigate risks, and govern AI interactions.

2026-11-13.headline: Purview Unified Catalog guidance adds Fabric-consolidation notice and new-account restriction
2026-11-13.overview: The day was dominated by a retirement notice added across Unified Catalog and classic Microsoft Purview data governance guidance. Updated pages now state that these capabilities are being consolidated in Microsoft Fabric and that new accounts can no longer be created. The supplied guidance includes no migration deadline or specific migration procedure. A separate Communication Compliance update clarifies permissions for the Information Barriers SharePoint report.
2026-11-13.adminImpact: Administrators planning new governance deployments should account for the stated inability to create new Purview accounts and the consolidation into Microsoft Fabric. Existing environments should be assessed against the transition language on individual capability pages. For Information Barriers reporting, review whether SharePoint Embedded Administrator users should handle report execution and segment updates for user-owned containers.

keyChanges.title: Unified Catalog and classic governance pages add a retirement notice
keyChanges.detail: Updated Data Governance guidance now states that Unified Catalog and classic Purview data governance capabilities are being retired and consolidated in Microsoft Fabric, and that new accounts can no longer be created. The Enterprise Glossary page supplies no deadline or specific migration step.

keyChanges.title: Self-service policy guidance preserves existing capabilities during transition
keyChanges.detail: The updated Azure SQL Database self-service policies page repeats the retirement and new-account restriction but explicitly says existing capabilities remain available during the transition.

keyChanges.title: Information Barriers report guidance names the SharePoint Embedded Administrator role
keyChanges.detail: Users with the SharePoint Embedded Administrator role can run the Information Barriers SharePoint report and update segments for user-owned containers.

2026-11-02.headline: Copilot DLP will exclude external email from grounding as retention coverage splits in 2027
2026-11-02.overview: Purview’s most consequential update is an admin-configurable DLP control that excludes email from external or untrusted domains from Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat grounding while preserving internal data use. The Message Center notice lists public preview in June 2026 and general availability in June 2027. Retention guidance separately sets January 15, 2027, as the point when “Teams chats and Copilot interactions” covers Teams content only; the remaining updates are mainly operational guidance for auto-labeling, simulations, and audit review.
2026-11-02.adminImpact: If Copilot retention coverage is required from January 15, 2027, create a separate retention policy using the “Microsoft Copilot Experiences” location; Teams retention behavior is unchanged. Plan auto-labeling against the 500,000-file-per-tenant-per-day aggregate ceiling across all policies, rather than treating it as a guaranteed rate. Use the added simulation statuses and audit activity names when interpreting results and records.

keyChanges.title: DLP adds external-email controls for Copilot grounding
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft Purview is expanding DLP with an admin-configurable control for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat. It restricts processing of emails from external or untrusted domains, excluding them from Copilot grounding while internal data use continues. The Message Center notice lists public preview in June 2026 and general availability in June 2027.

keyChanges.title: Teams retention location drops Copilot interactions in 2027
keyChanges.detail: Beginning January 15, 2027, policies using “Teams chats and Copilot interactions” will apply only to Teams content and will no longer retain or delete Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions, including previously retained interactions. The guidance directs administrators to use a separate “Microsoft Copilot Experiences” location when Copilot retention is required.

keyChanges.title: The 500,000-file auto-labeling ceiling applies across all policies
keyChanges.detail: Information Protection guidance now defines 500,000 automatically labeled SharePoint and OneDrive files per tenant per day, aggregated across all auto-labeling policies, as an absolute ceiling. It is not a guaranteed processing rate, and actual throughput may be lower.

keyChanges.title: Simulation results distinguish failed jobs from requests that never started
keyChanges.detail: The Auto Label Simulation Results guidance adds the “Simulation failed” status, distinguishes failed jobs from requests that could not start, explains partial workload counts, and provides review and restart guidance. Administrators can preserve useful results before restarting and inspect workload details before enabling a policy.

keyChanges.title: Audit references add Power BI MCP semantic-model activities
keyChanges.detail: The Audit Log Activities reference now lists events for Power BI MCP tools that modify semantic models and read semantic-model metadata. Administrators can use these activity names when reviewing or interpreting audit records.

2026-11-09.headline: Purview sets December 7 DSPM retirement as Unified Catalog pages flag no new accounts
2026-11-09.overview: The clearest operational deadline is December 7, 2026: Microsoft will retire select DSPM integrations for non-Microsoft data sources, ending ingestion and display for Varonis, BigID, Cyera, and OneTrust. A large group of November 13 Learn pages now states that Unified Catalog and classic Purview data governance capabilities are being retired and consolidated in Microsoft Fabric, with new accounts no longer available. Other substantive announcements cover late-November Edge for Business DLP setup changes, mid-2027 Endpoint DLP AI skills, and new RBAC audit operations; the documentation stream largely repeats the governance transition notice.
2026-11-09.adminImpact: Review dependencies on the four retiring DSPM integrations before December 7. The updated governance pages say new Purview accounts can no longer be created, so avoid planning new deployments around that path. Edge DLP requires no policy migration, Endpoint DLP's planned AI skills require Security Copilot, and the permissions-audit enhancement requires no action.

keyChanges.title: Selected DSPM integrations stop ingesting and displaying data December 7
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft will retire the Varonis, BigID, Cyera, and OneTrust integrations for non-Microsoft data sources on December 7, 2026. They will no longer ingest or display data, while other DSPM capabilities remain unaffected. Microsoft says no action is required but advises reviewing dependencies on these integrations.

keyChanges.title: Unified Catalog pages add a no-new-account retirement notice
keyChanges.detail: The updated Learn overview now states that Unified Catalog and classic Purview data governance capabilities are being retired and consolidated in Microsoft Fabric, and that new accounts can no longer be created. The supplied update does not provide a specific migration procedure or deadline.

keyChanges.title: Edge for Business unmanaged-app DLP setup adds Intune multi-admin approval
keyChanges.detail: Starting in late November 2026, setup and activation for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business will add Intune multi-admin approval, clearer status, detailed errors, and task coordination between Purview and Intune administrators. No policy migration is required.

keyChanges.title: Endpoint DLP AI skills target mid-2027 and require Security Copilot
keyChanges.detail: Endpoint DLP is planned to gain AI-powered Policy Sync and Device Health skills in a mid-2027 rollout. The skills will help identify affected devices, root causes, and remediation actions, and require Security Copilot to be enabled in the tenant.

keyChanges.title: Purview permissions auditing adds two RBAC audit operations
keyChanges.detail: The permissions audit log enhancement adds two audit operations for role-based access control, improving transparency and troubleshooting. Worldwide rollout runs from late September through mid-November 2026; Microsoft says no administrator action is required.

2026-11.headline: Purview sets a December 7 deadline for four DSPM integrations
2026-11.overview: The month’s clearest operational deadline is December 7, 2026, when Microsoft will retire Varonis, BigID, Cyera, and OneTrust integrations for non-Microsoft data sources; ingestion and display will stop, while other DSPM capabilities remain unaffected. A broad November 13 documentation update says Unified Catalog and classic Purview data governance capabilities are being retired and consolidated in Microsoft Fabric, and that new accounts can no longer be created. Other notable announcements cover Copilot’s external-email DLP control, late-November Edge for Business setup changes, and mid-2027 Endpoint DLP AI skills; most remaining activity was documentation refreshes.
2026-11.adminImpact: Review dependencies on the four DSPM integrations before December 7. Do not plan new Unified Catalog or classic Purview governance deployments around creating new Purview accounts; account for the stated consolidation in Microsoft Fabric. For the DLP announcements, note the published rollout windows, the Edge update’s lack of a policy-migration requirement, and Security Copilot as a prerequisite for the planned Endpoint DLP AI skills.

keyChanges.detail: Microsoft Purview will retire the Varonis, BigID, Cyera, and OneTrust integrations for non-Microsoft data sources on December 7, 2026. They will no longer ingest or display data; other DSPM capabilities remain unaffected. Microsoft says no action is required, but advises reviewing dependencies.

keyChanges.title: Updated guidance flags no new Purview accounts for Unified Catalog
keyChanges.detail: A November 13 FAQ update states that Unified Catalog and classic Microsoft Purview data governance capabilities are being retired and consolidated in Microsoft Fabric, and that new Purview accounts can no longer be created.

keyChanges.title: Copilot DLP will exclude external email from grounding
keyChanges.detail: The planned admin-configurable control restricts Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing email from external or untrusted domains. Those messages are excluded from Copilot grounding while internal data remains available. The notice lists public preview in June 2026 and general availability in June 2027.

keyChanges.title: Edge for Business DLP adds coordinated Intune setup
keyChanges.detail: Starting in late November 2026, DLP setup and activation for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business will add Intune multi-admin approval support, clearer status and error details, and task coordination between Purview and Intune administrators. No policy migration is required.
